cases.name: Diane "Jinx" Jenks
cases.about:
Her obituary said, "Born on Friday, the 13th, she was given the nickname Jinx. Jinx had many siblings and the entire family was close knit from childhood into adulthood. She had many passions but spending time with her family was always her number one priority.

In 1968 she married Ernie (Bum) Beatty and they welcomed son, Ernest “RAY” Beatty, Jr. In 1971, Michele Renae was born and they raised the children in Frankfort for years before moving to Flushing. Jinx had a strong work ethic and built several businesses from the ground up while working a second job. She owned Hair Masters salon in Frankfort and then Mic-J-Lin’s in Montrose when they moved downstate.

In 1989, Jinx divorced and moved back to the Frankfort/Elberta area. Again, she had several jobs, working hard so she could open her own salon: Shear Class Styling in Elberta. She had a knack at building something from nothing. She continued her education in cosmetology and became a hair color educator for Goldwell USA and Matrix Biolage; traveling across many states facilitating training sessions for hundreds in Michigan, Ohio, and in Las Vegas, NV.

In 1990, Jinx was reintroduced to Greg Jenks and the two became inseparable immediately. Greg moved to Elberta from New York and they were married in 1991. The two of them purchased and renovated a fire damaged home on Grant St. in Elberta where they resided from 1990-2021.

Always looking for a new project to invest in, the couple purchased and completely renovated a commercial building doing much of the work themselves. The two of them loved working together to build their financial future. In 2005, Jinx moved her salon to that space and renamed it A Shear Class Experience. She retired the business in 2021 after serving countless within the community at her salon. Several times she supported those that wanted to enter the profession by having them apprentice under her and later get their certification. She often used her salon as a community center hosting fundraisers as well as giving free services to those in need.

During her busy life of working and projects with Greg, Jinx also found time to spend with her kids, Ray & Michele, and stepdaughter, Sailin and their families. She was an active participant in all of their lives and enjoyed watching the grandchildren’s play sports, taking them swimming, and taking them on trips. Jinx was the epicenter of the family hosting annual Thanksgiving for up to 50 people.

After retiring from cosmetology, Jinx worked at Hospice of Michigan as a Spiritual Counselor. She touched so many people that were in hospice care as well as their families. She always went above and beyond and was at the bedside of those who passed at a number too high to count.

Jinx again retired, this time from Hospice of Michigan, only to pursue her own endeavors as a spiritual counselor, life coach, and healer in her Hedwig House Spiritual Center.

As if working, remodeling, parenting, and grandparenting weren’t enough to keep her busy, Jinx was an active member of her community AND spent years advancing her education to the PhD level. Some of her awards and educational achievements are listed below. Awards

Frankfort Rotary Club “Four Way Test Award”

2001 Michigan Society of Planners 2001 Outstanding Community Administrator Award,

2001 Citizen of the Year Award Presented by Crystal Masonic Lodge for OUTSTANDING DISTINGUISED SERVICE AND PERSONAL CONTRIBUTIONS OF TIME AND EFFORT TO THE COMMUNITIES OF FRANKFORT AND ELBERTA

Community Service

Served the Village of Elberta for 30 years in many capacities, that include EDC member and Chair, Village Trustee and Village President, Fund raising and boards too numerous to list

Served on the Board of the Non-profit “Community Spirt”

Frankfort Rotary Club

Frankfort Elberta Chamber of Commerce

Chaired the Benzie County American Cancer Society Relay for Life multiple years

Served the local Chapter of P.R.I.D.E.

Ministry and Metaphysical

2005 Received the honored title of Reiki Master

2012 Awarded the Degree of Bachelor of Divinity from the Universal Brotherhood Movement

2017 Awarded Practitioner Diploma from the International Metaphysical Ministry University Seminary

2017 Awarded Ordained Metaphysical Minister from the International Metaphysical Ministry University Seminary

2017 Awarded the Degree of Bachelor of Metaphysical Science from the University of Metaphysics

2018 Awarded the Degree of Master of Metaphysical Science from the University of Metaphysics

2020 Awarded The Degree of Doctor of Metaphysical Science from the University of Sedona

Jinx lived life to the fullest and gave more to others than they could possibly give back to her."
